bio: Glad you are here! My name is Đỗ Anh Thịnh. I am an Electronics and Telecommunications engineer with a strong interest in embedded systems, IoT, electronics, and connected devices.
My experience includes working with ESP32, sensors, communication protocols, embedded software, and IoT systems, with a focus on turning technical ideas into practical applications.
I enjoy developing complete systems from hardware to software, including sensor data acquisition, device communication, backend services, databases, and web interfaces.
My projects have covered household electricity and water monitoring, smart home systems, robotics, IoT monitoring, and other embedded and electronics applications.
My goal is to continue developing as an embedded and IoT engineer, combining electronics, firmware, communication technologies, and software to build reliable and useful real-world systems.

hero.title: Projects
hero.subtitle: The projects I have worked on, including personal projects, academic projects, and professional work.

smart_traffic_light.title: Smart Traffic Light
smart_traffic_light.description: Smart traffic light system using computer vision and embedded hardware to detect vehicles and support adaptive traffic control.
features: Real-time vehicle detection with YOLO
Adjust light timing based on traffic conditions
smart_traffic_light.architecture: YOLO for vehicle detection, Raspberry Pi for data processing and light control, connected to the network system for data transmission.

stemvn_bluecontrol.title: STEMVN BlueControl
stemvn_bluecontrol.description: Mobile application to control STEMVN educational robots via Bluetooth, allowing students to program and control robots easily.
features: Control STEMVN robot via Bluetooth
stemvn_bluecontrol.architecture: Mobile application connected to the robot via Bluetooth, using a drag-and-drop programming interface to create control commands.

land_slide_detection.title: Landslide Detection System
land_slide_detection.description: IoT landslide monitoring system using environmental sensors and LoRa communication to transmit monitoring data and alerts to a central system.
features: Detect landslide risks based on humidity, rainfall, and the tilt direction of the monitoring pillar
Send alerts via LoRa network to the central station
Central station sends data to the server using MQTT protocol
land_slide_detection.architecture: Sensors measuring humidity, rainfall, and tilt direction of the monitoring pillar send data via LoRa network to the central station, which processes the data and sends alerts to the server using MQTT protocol.

job_fit.title: JobFit
job_fit.description: Web application that helps users compare their skills and CV with job JDs to evaluate their fit with their CV.
features: Compare user skills and CV with job JDs
Evaluate user fit with jobs based on their skills and preferences
Suggest suitable jobs for users based on their skills and preferences
job_fit.architecture: Uses an embedding model to convert text into vectors, then uses cosine similarity to compare vectors and evaluate user fit with jobs.

products_crawl_tool.title: Product Data Crawling Tool
products_crawl_tool.description: Tool to crawl product data from e-commerce websites and convert the format into Excel or CSV for easy uploading to Sapo or Shopify.
features: Crawl product data from e-commerce websites
Dynamic configuration depending on each website
Convert data into Excel or CSV format for easy uploading to Sapo or Shopify
products_crawl_tool.architecture: Uses Python and libraries like Playwright to crawl data from e-commerce websites, then processes the data and exports it to Excel or CSV format.

flexiable_smarthome.title: Smart Home System
flexiable_smarthome.description: Smart home system using ESP32, sensors, MQTT, and WebSocket communication to monitor and control household devices through a software interface.
features: Devices can be added / edited / deleted flexibly via the mobile application
Control indoor devices via the mobile application
Authentication mechanism ensuring commands have been executed
flexiable_smarthome.architecture: ESP32 acts as the internet gateway and HMI, communicating with Arduino UNO via UART to control indoor devices. Communication uses MQTT and WebSocket.

smart_agriculture.title: Smart Agriculture System
smart_agriculture.description: IoT agriculture monitoring system using sensor nodes, LoRa, MQTT, and a server-side platform for collecting, storing, and visualizing environmental data.
features: Sensor nodes measuring humidity, temperature, and light
Transmit data between sensor nodes and gateway using LoRa
Packet authentication mechanism ensuring data is transmitted securely
Upload data to the server for storage and analysis using Grafana
Web application allowing users to manage sensor nodes and view real-time data
smart_agriculture.architecture: Sensor nodes use LoRa to transmit data to the gateway, the gateway processes the data and sends it to the server via MQTT. The server stores data in InfluxDB and provides APIs for the web application to manage and display data.

agriculture_ecommerce.title: Agricultural E-commerce Platform
agriculture_ecommerce.description: Agricultural e-commerce platform that helps agricultural suppliers sell their products online and users buy high-quality agricultural products from trusted suppliers.
features: Agricultural suppliers can register and sell their products online
Users can search for and buy high-quality agricultural products from trusted suppliers
Integrated payment and shipping systems to ensure smooth and secure transactions
Admin manages the e-commerce platform, including suppliers, products, and orders

household_energy_water.title: Household Electricity & Water Monitoring System
household_energy_water.description: Monitoring system for household electricity and water consumption using ESP32, PZEM-004T, and YF-S201 sensors, with data transmission and a web interface.
features: Measure household electricity consumption
Measure water flow and consumption
Collect and synchronize sensor data
Display monitoring data through a web interface
household_energy_water.architecture: ESP32 collects electricity and water data from PZEM-004T and YF-S201 sensors. Data is transmitted to the backend/cloud platform and displayed through the web application.
